title: docs: improve FFmpeg MCP description
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces implementation-focused FFmpeg copy with a concise list of user-facing capabilities
- Updates the MCP registry response expectation

gist.headline: FFmpeg, Minus the Manual
gist.blurb: The FFmpeg MCP listing now says what it can actually do, without making everyone read the plumbing first. Polli approves of tools that introduce themselves properly.
gist.summary: Rewrote the FFmpeg MCP registry description as a concise list of user-facing media capabilities and updated the MCP proxy test expectation to match.
gist.impact: People browsing MCP tools now get a clearer, capability-focused explanation of what the FFmpeg server can help them do.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the FFmpeg MCP tool as a friendly retro media-workbench: small film, audio-wave, and video-frame icons arranged as a simple capability menu instead of a dense technical manual. Polli, wearing tiny editor headphones, points warmly at the clear list while code-plants and flowers grow around a CRT terminal.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art media workshop where Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, light-blue translucent wings, and tiny editor headphones, points at a friendly CRT monitor showing simple pixel icons for video, audio, and film tools; code-plants bloom in pots nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: "FFMPEG MCP".
